# QR Code generator

Unmodified C++ source from [Nayuki's QR Code generator](https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator), commit `9a217d443937f60cc56c1458c39a211d7f2d3af5` (`cpp/qrcodegen.cpp` and `cpp/qrcodegen.hpp`). MIT license and copyright notices are retained in both source files.

`upstream.json` records the pinned revision and SHA-256 hashes. Do not run the repository formatter on these files. To upgrade, select a reviewed upstream commit, replace both files together, refresh the metadata/hashes, retain the notices and repeat QR decoding/pairing verification.

The app uses the library only to encode local pairing URLs. It has no network or platform dependencies. Desktop and test builds compile the same source.
